title: Fee rules: return fee, failed pickup, 50% cancellation
keywords: fee return fee failed pickup fee 50% cancellation charge customer
body: Return fee: only with the merchant's prior approval.
Failed pickup (agent arrived): one fee per location regardless of parcel count; none if only 1 of a batch failed.

50% cancellation fee: agent arrived and the item was not ready / wrong address / under-declared. Cancel with the correct status; the customer acknowledges the fee first. TikTok includes a 15+ min wait.
escalate: Refunds and payout disputes → Mabeline Xie (CFO).
